system.description:
With a flurry of swings, you release droplets of water into the immediate area before you turn your weapon on your foe. Make a melee Ninjutsu (or taijutsu) attack, dealing your [Weapon Damage] + 3d6 cold damage. On a hit, you call all of the released water droplets back acting like bullets returning back to your body.

All creatures of your choice, within 5 feet of you must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure they gain 2 ranks of Weakened from the bombardment of strikes across their body.

Hydrofication. Compare your attack result vs the AC of all creatures of your choice within 5 feet of you. Also, creatures that fail their saving throw are also Bruised.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above C-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the damage by 1d6. If this jutsu is cast at A-Rank, increase the ranks of Weakened inflicted by +1.
